title: Andharangam
overview: Thangadurai does not talk to his wife assuming that she has cheated him. However, after many years of married life, he gets attracted towards Kanaga, who is after his wealth.

title: Podhuvaga En Manasu Thangam
overview: Set in a village in Tamil Nadu, Ganesh and Oothukaattan are two very different men who oppose each other.

title: Nagesh Thiraiyarangam
overview: Nagesh Thiraiyarangam is a 2018 Indian Tamil horror drama movie starring Aari, Ashna Zaveri, and Masoom Shankar. The story revolves around Nagesh, who decides to sell his father's old theatre to arrange money for his sister's marriage. What happens when Nagesh realises that the theatre is haunted?

title: Chellamae
overview: Revolving around a joint family system and its dynamics, this drama series attempts to highlight the challenges that emerge in relationships when money comes into the picture.

title: Samsaram Oka Chadarangam
overview: Samsaram Oka Chadarangam is a family drama which is a remake of a Tamil superhit Samsaram Adhu Minsaram. Due to the difference in their ideologies, an egoistic son (Sarath Babu) starts to fight with his father (Gollapudi Maruthi Rao) and they divide the house into two parts. Now the responsibility is on the son's wife (Suhasini) to bring peace between the two.
